summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited, a foreign private issuer, to disclose a planned revision of its consolidated financial statements due to a subsequent event: a May 18, 2026 jury verdict in the AMITIZA antitrust litigation. The filing notes that under Japanese GAAP the verdict is not an adjusting event for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, but it will be reflected in the IFRS-based earnings report and will not materially impact FY2026 guidance. No special-situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring is involved.
